chinese.title: AI 对话模式
chinese.welcome:
直接输入问题开始对话。
输入 [bold]/help[/] 查看所有指令，[bold]/exit[/] 返回 shell。
chinese.no_key:
[bold yellow]未检测到 API 密钥[/]

请输入 32 位密钥以使用 AI 功能。
输入 `/exit` 或留空回车可返回 shell。
chinese.key_bad_len: [bold red]密钥格式错误（需 32 位）[/]
chinese.unknown_cmd: 未知指令: {cmd}。输入 /help 查看可用指令。
chinese.model_usage: 用法: /model — 列出可用模型并切换
chinese.model_select_prompt: 输入序号切换模型 (直接回车取消):
chinese.esc_marked: 已标记，AI 本轮完成后会询问你
chinese.ask_after_esc: 有什么要补充或修改的吗？直接输入或按 Enter 跳过
chinese.help_intro: 直接输入问题即可与 AI 对话。AI 会记住本次会话的上下文。
chinese.help_tips:
- 按 `Esc` 两次可中断当前 AI 请求
- 按 `Ctrl+C` 可中断等待中的命令
- 输入 `/exit` 返回正常 shell
chinese.param_no_custom: [dim]无自定义参数（全部使用默认值）[/]
chinese.param_usage_full: [yellow]用法: /param <名称> <值> 或 /param 查看全部[/]
chinese.param_valid_names: [dim]可用参数: temperature, top_p, max_tokens, reasoning_effort[/]
chinese.compact_queued: 📦 对话压缩请求已排队，下一轮 AI 调用前执行
chinese.tool_desc.get_file_info: 获取文件信息：大小、修改时间、行数、类型。改文件前先调用了解概况。
chinese.tool_desc.read_file: 读取文件内容。支持行号范围 range/head/tail。超过 64 KiB 的大文件自动返回大纲模式（文件大小、前 80 行、符号大纲与钻取提示）。改文件前务必先读。
chinese.tool_desc.glob_search: 用 glob 模式查找文件，如 'src/**/*.ts'。
chinese.tool_desc.grep_search: 用正则搜索文件内容，支持上下文行与大小写控制。
chinese.tool_desc.search_file: 按文件名关键字递归查找（自动跳过 node_modules/.git/__pycache__ 等）。返回完整路径。
chinese.tool_desc.ToolSearch: 按名称/关键字搜索可用工具；不确定用哪个工具时调用。
chinese.tool_desc.Skill: 加载并执行技能剧本（预定义可复用流程）。
chinese.tool_desc.Sleep: 等待指定秒数；用于监控或等待异步操作。
chinese.tool_desc.StructuredOutput: 按请求格式返回结构化数据；format='json' 返回 JSON 字符串。
chinese.tool_desc.TodoWrite: 更新会话任务列表，跟踪多步骤进度；status=completed 表示该步完成。
chinese.tool_desc.write_file: 创建新文件或全量覆盖（仅新建或 >70% 变动；局部修改用 edit_file）。>20KB 新文件先建骨架，再分多次 edit_file 填入。
chinese.tool_desc.edit_file: SEARCH/REPLACE 精确替换；old_string 须逐字节匹配且唯一；改前先 validate_edit 校验；保留缩进。写入大文件必须分块：骨架 + 多次 edit_file（每块 <200 行），禁止一次性全量 write_file。
chinese.tool_desc.validate_edit: 校验 SEARCH 文本在目标文件中存在且唯一；每次 edit_file 前务必先调用。
chinese.tool_desc.preview_edit: 预览 edit_file 的 unified diff，确认正确后再编辑。
chinese.tool_desc.remember: 标记 library 会话为重要（提升保留等级，不被压缩清理）。
chinese.tool_desc.forget: 归档 library 会话（移至 .archive/，可恢复）。
chinese.tool_desc.memory: 操作 library 历史会话：search 按关键词搜索；list 列出活跃记忆；read 用 session_id 读完整记录。
chinese.tool_desc.compact_stats: 查看 library 压缩状态：活跃/归档数、估算 token、触发阈值。
chinese.tool_desc.choose_ask: 不确定用户意图时提供选项；用户可选「以上都不是」自由输入。
chinese.tool_desc.submit_plan: 提交多步骤计划给用户确认；plan 与 steps 二选一。确认后才可执行；复杂任务必须先提交计划。
chinese.tool_desc.mark_step_complete: 标记步骤已完成；批准的计划每完成一步即调用。
chinese.tool_desc.EnterPlanMode: 进入计划模式（禁止命令与文件修改，只能输出计划）；进入后应立即用 submit_plan 提交计划。
chinese.tool_desc.ExitPlanMode: 退出计划模式，恢复正常执行；计划确认后调用并开始执行。
chinese.tool_desc.Config: 获取或设置 Onyx 配置：get 返回当前配置，set 设置键值。
chinese.tool_desc.Agent: 启动子代理（隔离上下文，总结后喂回主 AI）。类型：explore=只读调查；plan=规划（只读+git）；lint=代码分析（可经安全管线跑分析命令）；test=测试（可经安全管线跑测试）。可指定 1~3 个任务并行。mode=sync 阻塞等待总结；mode=async 立即返回，完成后结果自动注入会话。
chinese.tool_desc.WebFetch: 获取 URL 并转为可读文本。需用户批准。
chinese.tool_desc.WebSearch: 搜索网络获取最新信息并返回引用。需用户批准。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskCreate: 创建结构化任务：传 prompt 建简单任务，或传 TaskPacket 字段（objective/scope/acceptance_criteria 等）建完整任务包。返回任务 ID。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskList: 列出任务，可按状态过滤；状态：created/running/blocked/completed/failed/stopped。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskGet: 查看单个任务详情（含消息记录和输出）。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskUpdate: 更新任务状态或追加消息；status 可选值：created/running/blocked/completed/failed/stopped。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskStop: 终止任务；仅限非终态（completed/failed/stopped）任务。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskBoard: 看板视图：active（created/running）/blocked/finished 三栏展示任务及心跳状态。
chinese.tool_desc.TaskRemove: 从注册表删除任务。不可恢复。
chinese.tool_desc.TeamCreate: 创建团队，可选关联任务 ID 列表。
chinese.tool_desc.CronCreate: 创建定时任务；schedule 为 cron 表达式，如 '0 * * * *'（每小时）。
chinese.tool_desc.CronList: 列出定时任务，可选仅显示启用的。
chinese.tool_desc.CronDisable: 禁用定时任务，停止其调度。
chinese.tool_desc.py_diagnostics: 检查 Python 语法/编译错误（仅真实编译失败时报错，无启发式判断）。零依赖内置。
chinese.tool_desc.py_symbols: 归拢文件中的函数/类定义及其精确位置（path:line）。零依赖内置。
chinese.tool_desc.LspDiagnostics: 获取文件编译错误（仅 error 级别，不显示警告/提示等主观信息）。按扩展名自动启动语言服务器。
chinese.tool_desc.LspSymbols: 归拢文件中的函数/类定义及其位置（符号名、类型、path:line）。
chinese.tool_desc.MemoryRead: 读取记忆文件，支持行号范围。路径示例：chat/first、library/<uuid>、onyx_ai。结果自动缓存。
chinese.tool_desc.MemorySearch: 在记忆文件中搜关键字，默认显示匹配行上下各 3 行（含行号）；uuid 指定单个会话或 all 全范围。结果自动缓存。
chinese.tool_desc.UndoLastEdit: 撤销上一次文件编辑或写入，恢复修改前内容；仅在存在撤销记录时可用。
chinese.tool_desc.ListDirectory: 列出目录内容；目录以 / 结尾。
chinese.tool_desc.DirectoryTree: 递归显示目录树；目录以 / 结尾，默认最大深度 2。
chinese.tool_desc.GitStatus: Git 工作区状态（相当于 git status --short）。
chinese.tool_desc.GitDiff: Git 未暂存变更（相当于 git diff），文件级 diff。
chinese.tool_desc.GitLog: Git 提交历史（相当于 git log --oneline）。
chinese.tool_desc.GitBranch: Git 分支信息（相当于 git branch -a）。
chinese.tool_p.read_file.range: 可选行号范围，如 '10-30' 或 '42'（单行）
chinese.tool_p.read_file.head: 可选：只读前 N 行（钻取大文件大纲）
chinese.tool_p.read_file.tail: 可选：只读末尾 N 行（钻取大文件大纲）
chinese.tool_p.glob_search.path: 可选搜索根目录，默认当前工作目录
chinese.tool_p.grep_search.-i: 可选忽略大小写，默认 false
chinese.tool_p.search_file.pattern: 文件名关键字（子串匹配，不区分大小写）或 glob 模式
chinese.tool_p.search_file.path: 可选搜索根目录，默认当前工作目录
chinese.tool_p.TodoWrite.todos.activeForm: 进行中状态的动名词描述，如'正在分析架构'
chinese.tool_p.edit_file.old_string: 要替换的旧文本（逐字节精确匹配，必须唯一）
chinese.tool_p.edit_file.replace_all: 可选：是否替换所有匹配项（默认只替换第一个）
chinese.tool_p.validate_edit.search: 要搜索的旧文本（逐字节精确匹配）
chinese.tool_p.memory.query: 搜索关键词（search 时必填）
chinese.tool_p.memory.filter: 过滤 class 等级（list 时可选）
chinese.tool_p.choose_ask.question: 向用户提出的问题
chinese.tool_p.choose_ask.options: 选项列表（至少2个，最多6个）
chinese.tool_p.submit_plan.steps.title: 简短标题
chinese.tool_p.Agent.name: 可选子代理名称
chinese.tool_p.Agent.mode: sync=等待完成并返回总结；async=后台运行，完成自动注入（默认 sync）
chinese.tool_p.Agent.model: 可选模型名覆盖（默认当前平台最便宜模型，即 X Pro）
chinese.tool_p.Agent.count: 并行 Explore 数量 1~3（默认 1；tasks 存在时按 tasks 长度）
chinese.tool_p.Agent.tasks: 可选：1~3 个子任务数组，每个元素启动一个 Explore 子代理
chinese.tool_p.WebFetch.prompt: 关于获取内容的具体问题
chinese.tool_p.TaskCreate.prompt: 任务描述（简单模式），或 TaskPacket.objective
chinese.tool_p.TaskCreate.scope_path: 作用域路径（module/single_file/custom 时需要）
chinese.tool_p.TeamCreate.name: 团队名称
chinese.tool_p.TeamCreate.task_ids: 可选关联任务 ID 列表
chinese.tool_p.CronList.enabled_only: 是否只显示启用的条目（默认 false）
chinese.tool_p.MemoryRead.path: 记忆路径（如 chat/first, library/<uuid>, onyx_ai）
chinese.tool_p.MemoryRead.range: 可选行号范围，如 '1-30' 或 '50'（单行）
chinese.tool_p.MemorySearch.uuid: 目标记忆 UUID，或 'all' 表示全范围查找（默认 all）
chinese.tool_p.MemorySearch.-i: 可选忽略大小写，默认 true
chinese.tool_p.ListDirectory.path: 要列出的目录路径，默认当前目录
chinese.tool_p.DirectoryTree.path: 目录树根目录，默认当前目录
chinese.tool_p.DirectoryTree.maxDepth: 最大递归深度，默认 2，最大 5
chinese.tool_p.GitStatus.path: Git 仓库路径，默认当前目录
chinese.tool_p.GitDiff.path: Git 仓库路径，默认当前目录
chinese.tool_p.GitDiff.staged: 是否显示已暂存变更（git diff --staged），默认 false
chinese.tool_p.GitLog.path: Git 仓库路径，默认当前目录
chinese.tool_p.GitBranch.path: Git 仓库路径，默认当前目录

english.title: AI Chat Mode
english.welcome:
Type your question to start chatting.
Type [bold]/help[/] for commands, [bold]/exit[/] to return to shell.
english.no_key:
[bold yellow]No API key detected[/]

Enter your 32-char key to use AI features.
Type `/exit` or press Enter to return to shell.
english.unknown_cmd: Unknown command: {cmd}. Type /help for available commands.
english.model_usage: Usage: /model — list available models and switch
english.model_select_prompt: Enter number to switch (Enter to cancel):
english.esc_marked: Marked, AI will ask you after this round
english.ask_after_esc: Anything to add or change? Type or press Enter to skip
english.help_intro: Type your question directly to chat with AI. Context is maintained within the session.
english.help_tips:
- Press `Esc` twice to interrupt AI request
- Press `Ctrl+C` to interrupt running commands
- Type `/exit` to return to shell
english.compact_queued: 📦 Compression queued — runs before next AI call
english.tool_desc.get_file_info: File info: size, mtime, line count, type. Call before modifying a file.
english.tool_desc.read_file: Read file content. Supports line ranges (range/head/tail). Files over 64 KiB auto-return outline mode (size, first 80 lines, symbol outline, drill-down hints). Always read before editing.
english.tool_desc.grep_search: Regex search of file contents; supports context lines and case control.
english.tool_desc.search_file: Recursively find files by name keyword (skips node_modules/.git/__pycache__ etc.). Returns full paths.
english.tool_desc.ToolSearch: Find tools by name/keyword; use when unsure which tool to call.
english.tool_desc.Skill: Load and run a skill playbook (predefined reusable workflow).
english.tool_desc.Sleep: Wait N seconds; for monitoring or async operations.
english.tool_desc.StructuredOutput: Return structured data in the requested format; format='json' returns JSON.
english.tool_desc.TodoWrite: Update the session todo list for multi-step tracking; status=completed means done.
english.tool_desc.write_file: Create/overwrite a file (only new files or >70% changes; use edit_file for partial edits). Files >20KB: write a skeleton first, then fill in with edit_file.
english.tool_desc.edit_file: SEARCH/REPLACE exact edit; old_string must match byte-for-byte and be unique; validate with validate_edit first; preserve indentation. Large files MUST be written in chunks: skeleton + multiple edit_file calls (<200 lines each) — never one full write_file.
english.tool_desc.validate_edit: Verify SEARCH text exists and is unique; always call before edit_file.
english.tool_desc.preview_edit: Preview edit_file's unified diff before executing.
english.tool_desc.remember: Mark a library session important (raises retention, never compressed away).
english.tool_desc.forget: Archive a library session (move to .archive/, recoverable).
english.tool_desc.memory: Operate library history: search=keyword, list=active memories, read=full record by session_id.
english.tool_desc.compact_stats: Library compression stats: active/archived count, estimated tokens, threshold.
english.tool_desc.choose_ask: Offer options when unsure of user intent; user can pick 'none of the above' and type freely.
english.tool_desc.submit_plan: Submit a multi-step plan for confirmation; plan or steps (either). Execute only after confirmation; complex tasks MUST use this first.
english.tool_desc.mark_step_complete: Mark a step completed; call after each step of an approved plan.
english.tool_desc.EnterPlanMode: Enter plan mode (no commands/file changes — plan only); call submit_plan right after.
english.tool_desc.ExitPlanMode: Exit plan mode, resume normal execution; call after plan confirmation.
english.tool_desc.Config: Get/set Onyx config: get returns config, set writes a key.
english.tool_desc.Agent: Spawn a subagent (isolated context, summary fed back to main AI). Types: explore=read-only investigation; plan=planning (read-only + git); lint=code analysis (may run analysis commands via the security pipeline); test=runs tests via the security pipeline. Specify 1-3 parallel tasks. mode=sync blocks for the summary; mode=async returns immediately and injects results when done.
english.tool_desc.WebFetch: Fetch a URL and extract readable text. Requires approval.
english.tool_desc.WebSearch: Web search with citations. Requires approval.
english.tool_desc.TaskCreate: Create a structured task: pass prompt (simple) or TaskPacket fields (objective/scope/acceptance_criteria etc.). Returns task ID.
english.tool_desc.TaskList: List tasks, optional status filter; statuses: created/running/blocked/completed/failed/stopped.
english.tool_desc.TaskGet: View a single task's details (messages + output).
english.tool_desc.TaskUpdate: Update task status or append a message. Status values: created, running, blocked, completed, failed, stopped.
english.tool_desc.TaskStop: Stop a task. Only non-terminal (completed/failed/stopped) tasks can be stopped.
english.tool_desc.TaskBoard: Board view — three columns (active/blocked/finished) showing all tasks and heartbeat status.
english.tool_desc.TaskRemove: Delete a task from the registry. Irreversible.
english.tool_desc.TeamCreate: Create a team, optionally linked to task IDs.
english.tool_desc.CronCreate: Create a cron task entry. schedule is a cron expression like '0 * * * *' (hourly).
english.tool_desc.CronList: List all cron tasks, optionally only enabled ones.
english.tool_desc.CronDisable: Disable a cron task and stop its scheduling.
english.tool_desc.py_diagnostics: Check Python syntax/compile errors (reports ONLY real compile failures, no heuristics). Zero-dependency builtin.
english.tool_desc.py_symbols: Collect all defined functions/classes and their exact locations (path:line). Zero-dependency builtin.
english.tool_desc.LspDiagnostics: Get compile errors only (error severity; no warnings/hints — subjective info is suppressed). Auto-starts the language server for the file extension.
english.tool_desc.LspSymbols: Collect all function/class definitions and their locations (name, kind, path:line).
english.tool_desc.MemoryRead: Read memory file content, supports line ranges. Memory lives in ~/.ai_s/chat/ (dialogs), ~/.ai_s/library/ (session archives), ~/.ai_s/onyx_ai.md (persistent prompt). Results are cached.
english.tool_desc.MemorySearch: Search keywords in memory files; shows ±3 context lines with line numbers by default. uuid targets a single memory session or 'all' for full-range search. Results are cached.
english.tool_desc.UndoLastEdit: Undo the last file edit or write, restoring the original content. Only works when an undo record exists.
english.tool_desc.ListDirectory: List entries in a directory. One entry per line, directories marked with /.
english.tool_desc.DirectoryTree: Recursively show directory tree. Dirs marked with /, max depth 2 by default.
english.tool_desc.GitStatus: Show git working-tree status (like git status --short). Returns modified/added/deleted files.
english.tool_desc.GitDiff: Show unstaged git changes (like git diff). File-level diff output.
english.tool_desc.GitLog: Show git commit history (like git log --oneline). Recent commits.
english.tool_desc.GitBranch: Show git branches (like git branch -a). All local and remote branches.
english.tool_p.read_file.range: Optional line range, e.g. '10-30' or '42' (single line)
english.tool_p.read_file.head: Optional: read only the first N lines (drill into large-file outline)
english.tool_p.read_file.tail: Optional: read only the last N lines (drill into large-file outline)
english.tool_p.glob_search.path: Optional search root, defaults to CWD
english.tool_p.search_file.pattern: Filename keyword (substring, case-insensitive) or glob pattern
english.tool_p.search_file.path: Optional search root, defaults to CWD
english.tool_p.TodoWrite.todos.activeForm: Gerund form for in-progress state, e.g. 'analyzing architecture'
english.tool_p.edit_file.old_string: Old text to replace (byte-exact match, must be unique)
english.tool_p.edit_file.replace_all: Optional: replace all matches (default: first only)
english.tool_p.memory.filter: Filter by class level (optional for list)
english.tool_p.choose_ask.question: Question to ask the user
english.tool_p.submit_plan.steps.title: Short title
english.tool_p.Agent.name: Optional subagent name
english.tool_p.Agent.mode: sync=wait for summary; async=run in background, auto-inject on completion (default sync)
english.tool_p.Agent.model: Optional model override (default: cheapest model of current platform, aka X Pro)
english.tool_p.Agent.count: Parallel Explore count 1-3 (default 1; uses tasks length if tasks given)
english.tool_p.Agent.tasks: Optional: array of 1-3 subtasks, one subagent each
english.tool_p.TeamCreate.name: Team name
